title: Global derived Hom for completed adic coefficients
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $A$ be a commutative ring with an adic coefficient datum $d$ and completed sheaf $A_T$ on the small pro-etale site as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $\operatorname{Mod}(A_T)$ for [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $D$ for its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the continuous-function presentation and module-category notation of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For every object $U$ of the small pro-etale site, define the scalar map $A\to\Gamma(U,A_T)$ to be the unique ring homomorphism whose projection to each positive finite quotient is the sheafification of the constant residue section. Define $\Gamma(T,-):\operatorname{Mod}(A_T)\to\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ by evaluation on the final object of $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and restriction of scalars along that map. Define global derived Hom as the bifunctor $R\operatorname{Hom}_{A_T}(-,-):=R\Gamma(T,R\mathcal{H}om_{A_T}(-,-)):D^{\mathrm{op}}\times D\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(A))$, where internal derived Hom is [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and $R\Gamma$ is the unbounded right derived functor computed using K-injective resolutions. Its fixed-source functor is denoted $R\operatorname{Hom}_{A_T}(K,-)$.
